The user asks: "You are agent A. Choose exactly one task for yourself. ... You are an ORIGINAL agent before replacement. Your assigned joint allocation is {"A":"T2","B":"T3"}. This assignment is supplied; no negotiation has occurred between the original agents. Return ONLY JSON {"task":"your assigned task","reason":"brief reason"}."

So they want us to output JSON with task = the assigned task for A, which is T2, and a brief reason.

Thus output: {"task":"T2","reason":"assigned joint allocation"} or similar. Must be only JSON. No extra text.

Thus answer.
